4 افحش , (Msb, K,) or افحش فِى المَنْطِقِ, (S,) or فِى الكَلَامِ, (Mgh,) or فِى كَلَامِهِ, (A,) inf. n. إِفْحَاشٌ and ↓ فُحْشٌ , accord. to Lh and Kr, but the latter is correctly a simple subst. [used as an inf. n. of this verb], (TA,) He uttered فُحْش, (S, A, Mgh, Msb, K,) i. e., foul, evil, bad, abominable, unseemly, [gross, immodest, lewd, or obscene,] speech or language; (Mgh, Msb;) as also ↓ فَحَشَ فى المنطق, (TA,) and فى الكلام ↓ فحّش , (Mgh,) or فى كلامه, (A,) and فى كلامه ↓ تفحّش : (S, A:) and ↓ تَفَاحَشَ also signifies the same; and he manifested, discovered, or revealed, or he made a show of, such speech or language. (O, * K, * TA.) You say, افحش عَلَيْهِ فِى المَنْطِقِ [He uttered such speech or language against him]; (S;) and in like manner, ↓ فَحَشَ , (TA,) and ↓ فحّش ; (Mgh;) and عَلَيْهِ بِلِسَانِهِ ↓ تفحّش . (TA.) ―
-b2- Also افحش He was, or became, niggardly, tenacious, or avaricious. (Msb.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
